name: stellar
description: Agent-assisted website studio and client portal.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@stellar/web && npm run build:fixture
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && eslint scripts/check-fixture.mjs scripts/verify-local-runner.mjs test/fixture.test.mjs eslint.config.mjs test/editor-e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspace=@stellar/contracts && npm run test --workspace=@stellar/editor-core && npm run test --workspace=@stellar/runner && npm run test --workspace=@stellar/web && npm run test --workspace=@stellar/astro-editor-integration && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run verify:harness && npm run verify:docs && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run verify:fixture
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@stellar/editor-core && npm run build --workspace=@stellar/runner
scripts.dev:local: npm run build:packages && npm run launch --workspace=@stellar/runner
